answer: In an agent economy%2C one concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is physical-world proof-of-possession. Picture a single walnut sealed inside a rare opal-inlaid casket buried beneath a shifting dune in a remote desert. Only the genuine agent can locate and present the artifact when challenged%3B each additional fake identity would require its own expensive%2C hard-to-retrieve real object%2C making large-scale identity farming prohibitively costly.
